deliverables: Open, standardized interface across Cardano on-chain protocols
12 additional protocol onboardings over 12 months, three per quarter
Developer and agent coverage for onboarded protocols
Documentation, auto-generated SDKs in multiple languages, and live JSON-RPC endpoints
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor TxPipe.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is intended to provide a standard open-source interface to Cardano protocols through documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live RPC endpoints.
The proposer states that Cardano currently lacks a common interface mechanism across the ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and rebuild understanding independently.
The proposer states that TxPipe has already put the developer layer into production through Catalyst Fund 14 with five protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal funds 12 additional protocol onboardings, three per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage plus shared MCP server and skill framework infrastructure.
The proposer states that the proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
Independent oversight is described as being provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
TxPipe is disclosed as having received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and four under development and on schedule.
Treasury administration will use Sundae Labs smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based authorization thresholds, an Oversight Committee, and a public dashboard for auditing.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month TxPipe Tx3 project to expand standardized Cardano protocol interfaces, agent-facing documentation, MCP tooling, and protocol onboarding, with Intersect-administered smart-contract oversight and several externally checkable governance and audit references.
